rationale: Command list query previously had no explicit order; now sorted by description.
Merge-queue branch-update rule check removed from ref rule checks; pushes/API ref updates to branches with a merge queue previously rejected are now accepted.
Pure rename of txManager method executeWithResult to execute; behaviour identical.
Stub endpoints oauth/authorize and oidc/login now return 405 instead of 200; /oauth/redirect removed (now unrouted), /oauth/userinfo and /oidc/redirect added returning 405.

Removes env flag (default true) and automated-sync/source-type preconditions for revision-update optimisation in manifest generation; intended as performance-only, results same; parameter list reformatting.
Implicit subscription now inserted even when an inherited subscription exists; before it was skipped. Later subscription queries can show an extra own row.
Snapshots list applies a default limit from a new config value when no limit given; the config default is not in provided files.
Recommended-action notification on GitHub install webhook now attributed to the user matching the GitHub sender (optional) instead of the authenticated caller.
ViewNameResolver replaced by an interface relocated to another package with import changes only; no endpoint logic modified.
Nil registry now replaced by an empty registry; output for sessions remains zero counts.
Import path swapped from gobuffalo/pop to ory/pop fork; no code logic change.
Helper no longer treats TimeoutException as interrupted; internal utility, no visible HTTP effect shown.
Prometheus metrics servlet added on admin port only if an optional ECS metadata URI is configured; no API operation changed.
Identity import with passkey credentials lacking a user handle or credentials is now rejected with 400; previously accepted. TOTP import unchanged.
